ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface; approximate 95:5 ratio of dark-to-light pixels restricted to the ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark, low-intensity pigmentation across both visible lobes; no contiguous high-contrast mottling or focal geometric blobs detected on the central ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression characterized by an acute internal angle and a high depth-to-width bounding box ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations characterized by numerous sharp peaks and valleys along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature profile fitted to the trailing edges of both the left and right lobes extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters detected at the lateral distal tips of both fluke lobes, contrasting against the low-intensity primary surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular serration of the trailing edge and high-contrast calcified encrustations localized at the distal fluke tips.
